content.stem: 国家和行业风险评估应如何影响组织的风险基础方法和内部风险评估？

options.A: 应当恰当地引用这些信息，并将其纳入组织的风险评估中，以定制强化尽职调查（EDD）程序，并有效分配资源
options.B: 它们提供了一般性的指导，但无需直接考虑，因为内部风险因素更为重要
options.C: 它们仅应针对高风险客户进行参考，因为它们是为最坏的情况而设计的
options.D: 它们主要面向监管机构，不应影响组织的风险评估

content.stem_en: How should national and sectoral risk assessments influence an organization's risk-based approach and internal risk assessment?

options_en.A: They should be referenced and integrated appropriately into an organization's risk assessment to tailor enhanced due diligence (EDD) procedures and allocate resources effectively
options_en.B: They provide general guidance but do not need to be directly considered because internal risk factors are more important
options_en.C: They should only be referenced for high-risk clients as they are designed for worst-case scenarios
options_en.D: They are primarily intended for regulators and should not influence the organization's risk assessment
